rule: Fill-path only. Stamp name= stays catalog official_field_key (TIN/branch). Unstamped leftover writer keys may be copied onto the existing cell-id name= when the freeze sheet has exactly one fillable under a printed caption that matches one leftover-unique fields.json key, and the identity catalog names that cell as html_id_hint. That is not an official_field_key harvest. Text joins ASCII-uppercase letters into comb slots and data-writer-value for BIR CAPITAL LETTERS print; digits and punctuation are unchanged. Do not mutate profile/DB values. R3 peso+cent tax rows may be listed in money_joins: one leftover money key maps to peso_html_id plus cent_html_id. Split the writer {:.2} string: pesos right-aligned in the peso comb (leading slots empty, not zero-padded, no decimal glyph), cents in the 2-slot comb. Do not stamp name= on either comb. Do not left-align the dotted string into the peso comb. Leftover boolean/radio keys may be listed in xbox_joins: when the writer is true, put X in the catalog xbox (1-char text, not type=checkbox). Do not write the string true into the box. Do not join leftover keys that share an item number with another leftover except as documented here (For the Month MM/YYYY pair; Amended Return and Any Taxes Withheld Yes/No pairs).

joins.reason: exactly one 40-slot comb immediately under the item 8 caption; leftover-unique text key; catalog html_id_hint
exactly one full-width 40-slot comb immediately under the item 9 caption; leftover-unique text key; catalog html_id_hint
exactly one 3-slot comb on the TIN row under the item 7 caption; leftover-unique key; catalog html_id_hint
exactly one 4-slot comb under the ZIP Code caption; leftover-unique txtZipCode; catalog html_id_hint
exactly one 12-slot comb on the item 10 row; leftover-unique txtTelNum; catalog html_id_hint

exactly one 34-slot comb under the item 12 caption; leftover-unique txtEmail (unprefixed XML key); catalog html_id_hint. Catalog has no official_field_key (gap: no unique fields.json key for this box), so this is a fill-path join, not a stamp.

item 1 For the Month is MM + YYYY, not one cell. leftover txtMonth is the 2-slot comb immediately left of the year comb (left≈46pt, data-comb-slots=2) under the For the Month / (MM/YYYY) caption. Catalog html_id_hint with no official_field_key. Do not stamp name=. Do not put the month in p1c15 (item 4 sheets).

exactly one 4-slot year comb under For the Month, immediately right of the MM comb. leftover-unique integer txtYear; ZIP already uses date-yyyy-2. Catalog html_id_hint with no official_field_key. Shares fields.json item_number 1 with txtMonth; the join is the caption+cell pair, not leftover uniqueness of item 1.

money_joins.reason: Stage 3 R3 N:1 fill-path, not a catalog harvest. fields.json leftover-unique decimal-amount item 14. Freeze sheet has an 11-slot peso comb plus a 2-slot cents comb with the printed decimal between them. Catalog official_field_key is empty on both boxes. Split insert_money {:.2}; do not stamp name=.
Stage 3 R3 N:1 fill-path for the page-1 tax-withheld total users notice. Same peso+cent contract as txtTax14. Other Part II amount rows stay unjoined.

item 2 Amended Return No xbox (p1c22-i, left≈231.5) immediately left of the No label at x≈252. leftover AmendedRtn_2. Pair with AmendedRtn_1; leave blank when false so a non-amended draft marks No.
item 3 Any Taxes Withheld Yes xbox (p1c23-i, left≈304.7) immediately left of the Yes label at x≈323. leftover TaxWithheld_1. Catalog xbox, not type=checkbox. Fill X when writer is true.
